weak_videos.title: This Is How TATA Became India's Most Powerful Business Empire 🚀Description:
likely_reasons: Title is too long and likely cut off in the feed

what_works: India-Centric Geopolitics: Content about Indian cities, borders, and military (1962 War, Maritime Boundary) consistently exceeds the median.
Hindi/Hinglish Titles: The top 2 videos use Hindi script or heavy Hinglish, signaling relatability to the core audience.
Comparison & Rankings: 'Top 5 Powerful Countries' and 'India vs China' style content drives higher engagement.
Shock Value Emojis: High-performing videos use 😱, 😲, and 🇮🇳 effectively in titles.
Morning Slots: Publishing between 06:00 and 09:00 IST correlates with all videos exceeding 1,400 views.

diagnosis.hook: The bottom videos use 'Statement' hooks (e.g., Photosynthesis Explained) which provide no reason to stay. Top videos use 'Challenge' hooks (e.g., Bharat kis number par hai?).
diagnosis.buildup: Videos under 40 seconds generally perform better for this channel's current retention capability; the weak videos often hover around 48 seconds with slower academic pacing.
diagnosis.visuals: There is a 100% correlation between the lowest-performing videos and the absence of custom thumbnails.
diagnosis.titles_topics: The channel is pivoting from 'Mass Appeal India Facts' to 'Niche Global History/Science' in English, which is alienating the core Hindi subscriber base.
diagnosis.other: The 'like_pct' on low-view videos is actually very high (12-15%), suggesting the content quality is good, but the packaging (Title/Language) is preventing the algorithm from finding a broad audience.

hook_rules: Start with a question in Hindi script (e.g., 'Kya aapko pata hai?')
Use 'Negative Stakes' (e.g., 'Galti se bhi search mat karna')
Place a bold claim in the first 3 words
Use high-contrast text overlays in the first frame
Directly address the viewer ('Aapne kabhi socha hai?')
buildup_rules: Cut every 1.5 to 2 seconds to maintain visual momentum
Use a 'Wait for it' or 'But then...' transition at the 15-second mark
Remove all breath gaps in the voiceover
Use background music that shifts intensity as the story progresses
visual_rules: Custom thumbnails are mandatory for every Short
Use bright yellow or red text on thumbnails for readability
Ensure the main subject (e.g., a tank, a map, a face) is centered
Add a progress bar or visual countdown to discourage swiping away
title_rules: Mix Hindi script with English keywords (Hinglish)
Keep titles under 50 characters to avoid being cut off
Always include at least one 'reaction' emoji (😱, 🔥, 🛑)
topic_rules: Stick to 'India vs The World' or 'Hidden Indian History'
Connect global events to an Indian context (e.g., 'How UK's collapse affects India')
Focus on 'Wealth and Power' metrics (Cities, GDP, Military)
avoid: Publishing after 18:00 IST for this specific audience
Long intros or channel names in the first 5 seconds
